ai.description: This frog reaches 4–6 cm. It is brown with dark mottling and a distinct white upper lip stripe. Key features include expanded, truncate finger discs and granular skin on the flanks.
ai.identificationRemarks: *Amolops indoburmanensis* is best distinguished by the presence of a distinct, broad, cream-colored dorsolateral stripe that extends from the snout to the groin.
ai.habitat: *Amolops indoburmanensis* inhabits fast-flowing, rocky streams within evergreen tropical forests at elevations typically ranging from 200 to 1,000 meters.
ai.behavior: The Indoburman torrent frog is primarily nocturnal, remaining active along fast-flowing mountain streams where it hunts for small invertebrates under the cover of darkness.
ai.reproductionNotes: *Amolops indoburmanensis* breeds in fast-flowing streams during the monsoon (June–August), laying eggs in clutches attached to submerged rocks.
ai.distributionRemarks: *Amolops indoburmanensis* is found in the hilly regions of Northeast India, specifically in Manipur and Mizoram, at elevations between 200 and 1,000 meters.
ai.callDescription: The Indoburman Torrent Frog emits a series of high-pitched, rhythmic, metallic chirps while perched on rocks near fast-flowing mountain streams.
